method:
Order of judgement for a Parashari forecast, largest clock to smallest. (1) Fix the sidereal (Lahiri) Lagna sign; signs are whole-sign houses; classify each planet by houses owned, house held, dignity, association (BPHS Ch.34, Ch.11). This is the natal promise. (2) Vimshottari mahadasha lord judged from its natal placement AND its placement at the instant the dasha began (BPHS Ch.47 sl.3-6, Ch.48 sl.1, 6-8). (3) Antardasha lord by its own condition and its place counted from the mahadasha lord (BPHS Ch.52 onward, sampled). (4) Jupiter (yearly clock) and Saturn (about three-yearly) transits counted from the natal Moon sign with vedha (Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI; Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology Ch.XXXIV p.409, 415-416: a prediction is sound only when birth chart, dasha and gochara are blended). No source gives arithmetic for aggregation: strengths 1-3 are this project's reading of emphasis. English translations only; no Sanskrit read, so every sourceQuote is empty; verse numbers are that copy's and the OCR is noisy.

NOTES ON THE RULES: dasha rules are stated for the MAHADASHA; extension to the antardasha is this project's and is labelled so in output; 'lord of' is not widened to 'occupies' unless the verse says so; the Ch.34 sl.2-7 precedence (the predominant house lordship stalls the lesser) applies whenever one planet owns two houses; dignity and house are computed once and reused; sade sati is three separate per-sign rules, the grouping being a later convention; the dasha-lord-in-wealth-houses rule conflicts with Ch.48 sl.18-20 (planets in 3/6/11 unfavourable): flagged as a school conflict, both emitted with distinct dedupeKeys, never merged silently. Where there is a gap (Ch.48 sl.9-13 absent from this translation) it is stated.

topicDefinitions.definition: Money held and money coming in, from the 2nd house (wealth, grain, family, metals, gems) and the 11th (income, gain, prosperity); fortune and its support from the 5th and 9th; expenditure and loss from the 12th and 8th.
topicDefinitions.significators: Houses 2 and 11 (and their lords), houses 5 and 9 and their lords (their lords give wealth in their dashas), house 12 for outflow, 6/8/12 lords as drains.
topicDefinitions.source: BPHS Ch.11 sl.3, 12, 13; Ch.41 sl.16; Ch.34 sl.2-7 (that copy's numbering).

topicDefinitions.definition: Profession, standing, authority and honour from the 10th house, with recognition from authority.
topicDefinitions.significators: 10th house and its lord, planets in the 10th, the 10th lord's dasha; Lagna lord when linked with the 10th lord.
topicDefinitions.source: BPHS Ch.11 sl.11; Ch.48 sl.5-8 and 14-17.

topicDefinitions.definition: Spouse and partnership from the 7th house; wife is the stated meaning of the 7th. Venus is the indicator (karaka) of marital happiness only as Ch.18 names it. Convention-dependent (the sources address a male native).
topicDefinitions.significators: 7th house, 7th lord, Venus (as karaka strength), planets in the 7th; Jupiter transit over the 7th from the Moon is a favourable trigger.
topicDefinitions.source: BPHS Ch.11 sl.8; Ch.18 sl.14-18; Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI sl.19.

topicDefinitions.definition: Body from the Lagna; illness and enemies from the 6th; vulnerability and longevity from the 8th; loss from the 12th; the 2nd and 7th lords as maraka lords (shown only as a health caution, never mortality).
topicDefinitions.significators: Lagna and Lagna lord, 6th/8th/12th houses and lords, lords of 2 and 7, Saturn transits over the Moon sign and its eighth.

topicDefinitions.definition: Education, knowledge, mantra and intellect from the 5th house; religion, higher teaching and fortune from the 9th. The sources name education only under the dasha of the 5th and 9th lords; Phaladeepika's Jupiter-5th verse names children, friendship and royal favour, not learning.

Home, land, conveyances and mother from the 4th; journeys from the 3rd, 7th and 9th (shrines); foreign residence from the 10th. The 12th is expenses in Ch.11; travel or abroad for the 12th is later usage.
topicDefinitions.significators: 4th house and lord for home; 3rd, 7th, 9th, 10th houses and lords for travel.

topicDefinitions.definition: Overall fortune of the period, from the lord's functional nature for the Lagna, its dignity, placement and association, the dasha-antardasha relation and the transits.
topicDefinitions.significators: Dasha lord and antardasha lord condition; Jupiter and Saturn from the natal Moon.
topicDefinitions.source: BPHS Ch.34, Ch.47, Ch.48, Ch.52; Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI.

tables.HOUSE_TOPICS: BPHS Ch.11 sl.2-13, whole-sign houses from the sidereal Lagna: 1 body, appearance, intellect, vigour, innate nature; 2 wealth, grain, family, metals, gems, death, enemies; 3 valour, servants, brothers and sisters, initiation, journey, parents' death; 4 conveyances, relatives, mother, happiness, treasure, lands, buildings; 5 amulets, mantra, learning, knowledge, sons, authority, fall of position; 6 maternal uncle, enemies, ulcers, step-mother, doubts about death; 7 wife, travel, trade, loss of sight, death; 8 longevity, battle, enemies, forts, wealth of the dead; 9 fortune, wife's brother (also brother's wife), religion, visits to shrines; 10 authority, place, profession, honour, father, living in foreign lands, debts; 11 articles, son's wife, income, prosperity, quadrupeds; 12 expenses, history of enemies, one's own death. Sl.14-16: a house prospers when joined or aspected by a benefic, when its lord is in the 10th or vigorous, and suffers when its lord is with a malefic or a lord of 3,6,8,11,12 or defeated in war. Kendra 1,4,7,10; trikona 1,5,9; evil-lordship houses 3,6,8,11,12; dusthana 6,8,12.
tables.DASHA: Vimshottari (BPHS Ch.46: order sl.12-14, years sl.15, balance sl.16): from Krittika Sun, Moon, Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury, Ketu, Venus; years 6, 10, 7, 18, 16, 19, 17, 7, 20 (sum 120). The engine's sequence Ketu, Venus, Sun, Moon, Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury from Ashwini is the same cycle. Balance at birth = dasha years x unexpired part of the Moon's nakshatra. Year length (365.25, 360 or 365.2422 days) and ayanamsa are not settled by the sources: print the engine's convention with every result.
tables.DIGNITY: BPHS Ch.3 sl.49-55. Exaltation sign and deep degree: Sun Aries 10; Moon Taurus 3; Mars Capricorn 28; Mercury Virgo 15; Jupiter Cancer 5; Venus Pisces 27; Saturn Libra 20. Debilitation the seventh sign, same degree. Moolatrikona: Sun Leo 0-20 (rest own); Moon Taurus 3-30; Mars Aries 0-12 (rest own); Mercury Virgo 15-20 (0-15 exalted, 20-30 own); Jupiter Sagittarius 0-10 (rest own); Venus Libra 0-15 (rest own); Saturn Aquarius 0-20 (rest own). Sign lords: Aries and Scorpio Mars; Taurus and Libra Venus; Gemini and Virgo Mercury; Cancer Moon; Leo Sun; Sagittarius and Pisces Jupiter; Capricorn and Aquarius Saturn (Ch.4 read for Aries to Leo only). Friends (sl.55): signs 2,4,5,8,9,12 from a planet's moolatrikona sign plus the lord of its exaltation sign; other lords enemies; a planet that is a friend by one count and an enemy by the other is neutral (the 'or neither' case cannot occur). Temporary friend (sl.56): planet in 2,3,4,10,11,12 from it. Compound (sl.57-58): friend+friend great friend; friend+neutral friend; enemy+friend neutral; enemy+neutral enemy; enemy+enemy great enemy. Ch.3 sl.59-60 ratio of effects by dignity (exaltation full, moolatrikona three quarters, own one half, friendly one quarter, equal one eighth, enemy or debilitation nil) was not seen in the text read here, and is not included.
tables.LAGNA_NATURE: BPHS Ch.34 sl.19-44 as printed in the translation read (caveat: Taurus Venus, the Lagna lord, is listed malefic, and unmentioned planets are unstated, not neutral; check against the Sanskrit): Aries auspicious Jupiter, Sun; Mars helps the auspicious though 8th lord; malefic Saturn, Mercury, Venus. Taurus malefic Jupiter, Venus, Moon; auspicious Saturn (yogakaraka), Sun. Gemini malefic Mars, Jupiter, Sun; auspicious Venus only. Cancer malefic Venus, Mercury; auspicious Mars (yogakaraka), Jupiter, Moon. Leo malefic Mercury, Venus, Saturn; auspicious Mars, Jupiter, Sun. Virgo malefic Mars, Jupiter, Moon; auspicious Mercury, Venus; Venus+Mercury yoga. Libra malefic Jupiter, Sun, Mars; auspicious Saturn, Mercury; Moon+Mercury raja yoga. Scorpio malefic Venus, Mercury, Saturn; auspicious Jupiter, Moon; Sun and Moon yogakarakas. Sagittarius malefic Venus only; auspicious Mars, Sun. Capricorn malefic Mars, Jupiter, Moon; auspicious Venus (superior yoga), Mercury. Aquarius malefic Jupiter, Moon, Mars; auspicious Venus, Saturn; Venus the only raja-yoga planet. Pisces malefic Saturn, Venus, Sun, Mercury; auspicious Mars, Moon. Natural nature (Ch.34 sl.8-10): benefics Jupiter, Venus, Moon (full), Mercury (with benefics); malefics Sun, Saturn, Mars (and waning Moon); Rahu/Ketu follow lordship and conjunction (sl.16).
tables.DASHA_OF_HOUSE_LORD: BPHS Ch.48 sl.2-8 (to be qualified by dignity and placement; sl.9-13 are absent from this translation): Lagna lord physical well-being; 2nd distress and possible death; 3rd unfavourable; 4th house and land; 5th progress in education and happiness from children; 6th harm from opponents and sickness; 7th distress to wife and possible death; 8th possible death and financial losses; 9th improved education, religiosity, unexpected gain of wealth; 10th recognition from Government (read 'employer or authority'); 11th obstacles in gains, possible disease; 12th distress and disease. Sl.18-20: dashas of lords of 3, 6, 11, planets in 3, 6, 11 and planets joined to them are unfavourable; so are those joined to maraka lords (2, 7) in those houses and planets in the 8th; Rahu and Ketu are favourable in 3, 6, 11. Mortality statements are never printed.
tables.GOCHARA: Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI sl.2-8; Raman Ch.XXXIV p.412-413 (verified entry by entry in checking): good houses from the natal Moon / vedha house. Sun 3,6,10,11 / 9,12,4,5; Moon 1,3,6,7,10,11 / 5,9,12,2,4,8 (Moon's vedha not from Mercury); Mars 3,6,11 / 12,9,5; Mercury 2,4,6,8,10,11 / 5,3,9,1,8,12 (not from Moon); Jupiter 2,5,7,9,11 / 12,4,3,10,8; Saturn 3,6,11 / 12,9,5 (Sun does not obstruct Saturn); Venus good houses all except 6,7,10 BUT its vedha list is NOT used (the sl.8 wording is unclear; scoring Venus vedha is not advised until the wording is settled). Jupiter by house (sl.18-20): 1 leave country, spending; 2 money, domestic happiness, weighty speech; 3 loss of position, obstacle in business, disease; 4 sorrow through relations; 5 children, friendship of good people, royal favour; 6 enemies and disease; 7 auspicious travel, happiness with wife, children; 8 fatigue, bad luck, loss of money; 9 all prosperity; 10 danger to property, position, children; 11 children, new position, honour (Raman, not Phaladeepika, adds gain/wealth for 2, 9, 11); 12 grief and fear through property. Saturn by house (sl.22-23): 1 disease; 2 trouble to wealth and children; 3 position/employment, servants, money; 4 loss of wife, relatives, wealth; 5 wealth declines, loss of children, confusion; 6 happiness all round; 7 wife suffers, travel, fear; 8 loss of children, cattle, friends, wealth, disease; 9 loss in finance, obstacles to good action; 10 sinful deed, loss of honour, disease; 11 happiness, wealth, honour; 12 worthless business, money taken by enemies, sickness of wife and sons. Raman p.423 agrees in sign (3, 6, 11 good; 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 12 bad; 10 mixed: work with loss). Time-scale (Raman p.409): Saturn roughly triennial, Jupiter yearly, other planets monthly, the Moon daily.

rules.name: House signification map
rules.condition: Count houses by whole sign from the sidereal Lagna sign. Any rule that names a house uses tables.HOUSE_TOPICS.
rules.template: {planet} owns or occupies house {h} from the Lagna, which concerns {topics}.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation (compiled text with additions from Santhanam; title page not seen, so translator and publisher unconfirmed); chapter and verse numbers are that copy's. Translation in copyright; consulted for the sense and not quoted.
rules.variants: Ch.11 gives the 7th as wife, travel, trade and death, and the 12th as expenses and one's own death; later manuals list more. Only what Ch.11 states is in the table.

rules.name: Functional benefic or malefic by lordship
rules.condition: For each planet take the houses it owns from the Lagna. Lord of a trikona (5, 9) or the Lagna is auspicious; lord of 3, 6 or 11 gives evil results; lord of 8 is not auspicious (Sun and Moon exempt); lord of 12 depends on association. A natural BENEFIC owning a kendra (4, 7, 10) does NOT give benefic results; a malefic owning a kendra is auspicious only if it also owns a trikona (sl.14). Precedence (Ch.34 sl.2-7): the planet owning the predominant house stalls the lesser house it owns. The per-Lagna list (tables.LAGNA_NATURE) takes priority where it disagrees with the lordship rule.
rules.template: For a {lagna} Lagna, {planet} is a functional {nature} (lord of {houses}).
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: The per-Lagna lists do not always match the lordship rule (Tula: Moon+Mercury as the raja-yoga pair). Planets the text does not mention for a Lagna are unstated, not neutral. The Lagna lord is 'specially auspicious' yet the list calls Venus malefic for Taurus.
rules.verificationNote: Kendra clause reworded as the verse states (does not give benefic results, not 'turns inauspicious'); precedence added.

rules.name: Kendra-trikona connection (yoga)
rules.condition: A yoga requires two DIFFERENT planets: a kendra lord (4,7,10) and a trikona lord (5,9) that (a) exchange signs, or (b) are conjunct in a kendra or trikona, or (c) one sits in a house of the other kind, or (d) aspect fully (full seventh only; Ch.26 was not read). The Lagna lord alone does not pair with another kendra/trikona lord (the Lagna counts as both and sl.2-7 treat the Lagna lord separately). A single planet owning both a kendra and a trikona is a yogakaraka. Cancelled when the lords also own an evil house (3,6,8,11,12) unless the per-Lagna list says otherwise. A malefic owning a kendra is auspicious only if it also owns a trikona. Rahu or Ketu in a kendra joined with or aspected by a trikona or kendra lord also acts as yogakaraka.
rules.template: {p1} and {p2}, lords of houses {h1} and {h2}, form a kendra-trikona link; {planet} is the yogakaraka of this chart.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: The text says one born in the yoga becomes a king; the engine prints 'prominence and support in the period' only. The aspect chapter, Ch.26, was not opened.
rules.verificationNote: Two different planets required; aspect limited to the full seventh.

rules.name: Dignity of a planet by degree
rules.condition: Classify each sidereal planet position with tables.DIGNITY: deep exaltation degree, exaltation sign, moolatrikona span, own sign; debilitation is the seventh sign from exaltation with the same degree as deep fall. Friendship per tables.DIGNITY (a planet that is a friend by one count and an enemy by the other is neutral). Temporary friends are planets in the 2nd,3rd,4th,10th,11th,12th from it; compound relationship per sl.57-58. Computed once per planet and reused by every rule.
rules.template: {planet} is {dignity} at {deg} {sign}.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: Rahu and Ketu: Ch.47 sl.34-39 gives exaltation Taurus (Rahu) and Scorpio (Ketu), moolatrikona Gemini and Sagittarius, own Aquarius and Scorpio, and records that some sages give Virgo to Rahu and Pisces to Ketu. The reading of 'apart from the lord of exaltation rasi' cannot be settled from the English; a variant.

rules.name: Mahadasha of the 5th or 9th lord (and planets joined to them) gives wealth
rules.condition: MAHADASHA lord is the lord of the 5th or 9th house from the Lagna, or is conjunct (same sign, no orb in the text) that lord, and is not debilitated or placed in 6, 8, 12. If the lord also owns 6/8/12 apply Ch.34 sl.2-7 precedence. Extension to the antardasha is this project's, not the text's, and is labelled 'extension' in output.
rules.template: {planet}, {relation} the lord of the {h}th house, runs the period; Parashara's rule says such planets give wealth in their periods.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.sourceLocator: Ch.41 sl.16-17; also Ch.34 sl.2-7 (the 5th and 9th houses named for wealth)
rules.variants: Sl.17 says the yogas must be weighed by the favourable or unfavourable disposition and strength of the planets involved, so the dignity test is required, not extra.
rules.verificationNote: Stated for the dasha; antardasha extension labelled; conjunction defined.

rules.name: Mahadasha lord placed in the 2nd or 11th gives gain (by planet)
rules.condition: Natal placement, strong (not debilitated, no malefic affliction): Sun in the 11th (the 2nd only together with the 2nd lord); Moon in the 2nd or 11th (strong, benefic-aspected); Mars in the 2nd or 11th, or exalted, own, moolatrikona, kendra, with strength. Rahu/Ketu in the 11th good. Only Sun, Moon and Mars were read; Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn are not recorded. SCHOOL CONFLICT: Ch.48 sl.18-20 makes planets in 3, 6, 11 unfavourable; both rules emit and are never merged (separate dedupeKeys); the output shows the conflict.
rules.template: {planet}, placed in the {h}th house, runs the period; Parashara says {why}.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: The 2nd and 11th are houses of wealth by signification (Ch.11) but the dasha of the 2nd lord is called distressing in Ch.48 sl.2-4: placement versus lordship are different conditions.
rules.verificationNote: Per-planet conditions stated; Ch.47 versus Ch.48 conflict flagged.

rules.name: Mahadasha of the 10th lord
rules.condition: MAHADASHA lord owns the 10th house, is not debilitated and is not in 6, 8, 12. 'Or occupies the 10th' is dropped (not stated) and the Lagna-lord/10th-lord exchange is owned by parashari.lagna-karma-lord-exchange. Antardasha extension is unstated and labelled.
rules.template: {planet}, lord of the 10th house, runs the period; the source names credit and awards from the ruling power, read here as any person of authority.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.sourceLocator: Ch.48 sl.5-8 (recognition by Government in the dasha of the Karma lord) and sl.14-17 (exchange of Lagna lord and 10th lord)
rules.variants: The Ch.48 text speaks of the Government; reading it as 'employer or authority' is a paraphrase, not a source claim.
rules.verificationNote: 'Occupies' and exchange clause removed.

rules.name: Dasha of the 5th or 9th lord for study
rules.condition: Mahadasha lord owns house 5 or 9 (progress in education in the 5th lord's dasha, improvement in education and religion in the 9th lord's). Antardasha extension not stated in the text.
rules.template: {planet}, lord of the {h}th house, runs the period; the source says study moves forward in it.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: Qualified by dignity and placement (parashari.dasha-lord-placement-natal).

rules.name: Mahadasha of the 4th lord for home and land
rules.condition: MAHADASHA lord owns the 4th house. 'Occupies the 4th' is dropped; 'with the 4th lord' (conveyances) is stated only for the Sun's dasha. Valid only when the 4th lord is not itself weak or in 6/8/12 (Ch.48 sl.1). Antardasha extension unstated.
rules.template: {planet}, lord of the 4th house, runs the period; the source points to gaining a home, land or a vehicle.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: The text states the gain in sl.2-4 without the placement condition; the qualifier is from Ch.48 sl.1.
rules.verificationNote: Lordship only; occupancy dropped.

rules.name: Dasha lord tied to travel houses
rules.condition: Mahadasha or antardasha lord owns or occupies house 3, 7, 9 or 10 (journey, travel, shrines, foreign lands). The 12th is NOT used (Ch.11 gives it expenses, no travel). Ch.52 exile and difficult-journey verses are specific to Candra in Surya's dasha and are cited as such only.
rules.template: {planet} connects to the {h}th house, a house of journeys; travel or a move is a live topic in this period.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.sourceLocator: Ch.11 sl.4, 8, 10, 11; Ch.52 sl.7-10, 13-14 (Candra in Surya only)
rules.variants: The text attaches travel to both good and bad contexts, so direction is 'activates'.
rules.verificationNote: Houses restricted to 3,7,9,10; 12th removed.

rules.name: Dasha of the 7th lord (partnership)
rules.condition: Mahadasha lord owns the 7th house. 'Or is Venus' is deleted (no verse makes Venus's dasha a partnership dasha; Venus enters only as karaka strength, Ch.18 sl.18). If the 7th lord is exalted or in a kendra/trikona with a benefic: partnership favoured. If weak, in 6, 8, 12, in fall, or joined to a malefic: unfavourable. Dignity test is decisive; the death clause is never printed. Ch.52 sl.4-6 (marriage in Candra antardasha) is Candra-in-Surya only.
rules.template: {planet}, lord of the 7th house, runs the period; the partnership topic is live, and the lord is {strong_or_weak}.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.sourceLocator: Ch.18 sl.14-18; Ch.48 sl.5-8 (distress to wife in the dasha of the Yuvati lord); Ch.52 sl.4-6 (marriage in Candra antardasha when Candra is in kendra/trikona)
rules.variants: Ch.48 sl.5-8 states distress to wife and risk of death for the 7th lord's dasha, while Ch.18 and Ch.52 give marriage and gain when the planet is strong. Authorities differ. The marriage-age verses (Ch.18 sl.22-34) are excluded.
rules.verificationNote: Venus clause deleted.

rules.name: Mahadasha of maraka lords (2nd and 7th lords)
rules.condition: Mahadasha lord owns the 2nd or 7th house, or is joined to the 2nd/7th lord when that lord sits in the 2nd or 7th (NOT 'any planet sitting in the 2nd/7th'). Topic health only: strain flagged. The wealth topic was removed (no wealth loss stated for these lords). 'Stronger when the lord is weak or afflicted' is unsourced and dropped.
rules.template: {planet} is a maraka planet (lord of {h}) and runs the period; strain on health is flagged, not a prediction of death.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: The maraka chapter, Ch.44, was not opened. Present only 'health caution' wording, never mortality.
rules.verificationNote: Condition narrowed; wealth topic removed.

rules.name: Dasha of the lord of 6, 8 or 12
rules.condition: Mahadasha lord owns the 6th (enemies, ill health), 8th (possible financial loss and risk) or 12th (distress and danger from diseases) and is not redeemed (parashari.dasha-lord-6-8-12-redeemed). Wealth is negative for the 8TH lord only; 'outflow' for the 12th is not in the text. Sun and Moon owning the 8th are not evil (Ch.34 sl.2-7): exempt. Ch.34 sl.2-7 precedence applies for a lord of two houses.
rules.template: {planet}, lord of the {h}th house, runs the period; Parashara reads this dasha as {effect}.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: Ch.34 sl.2-7 says the 12th and 8th lords' result depends on association.
rules.verificationNote: Wealth limited to the 8th lord; Sun/Moon exemption inserted.

rules.name: 6/8/12 lord redeemed by a trikona lord
rules.condition: The 6th, 8th or 12th lord is conjunct a trikona lord, or a kendra lord is in a trikona (or a trikona lord in a kendra) and the dasha planet is joined to or aspected by either: then the dasha turns favourable.
rules.template: {planet}, normally unfavourable as lord of {h}, is redeemed by {lord2}; the period is read as favourable.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: Ch.48 sl.9-13 are missing from this translation.

rules.name: Dasha of the lord of 3, 6, 11 (and planets with them)
rules.condition: Mahadasha lord owns 3, 6 or 11, or sits in or is joined to such planets; Rahu and Ketu are exempt. The 6th lord is also scored by parashari.dasha-lord-6-8-12-lord: one signal, dedupeKey shared.
rules.template: {planet} owns the {h}th house, which gives evil results in its dasha; effect is reduced when the planet is strong.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: Ch.48 sl.5-8 says the 11th lord's dasha brings obstacles in gains and diseases, which sits uneasily with the 11th as the house of income in Ch.11 sl.12; the 11th lord's dasha is treated as mixed for wealth.

rules.name: Dasha lord's natal house and dignity
rules.condition: Mahadasha lord's natal house from the Lagna with dignity: 1, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10 (and for gain 2, 11) favourable; 6, 8, 12 unfavourable; exalted, own, moolatrikona, friendly favourable; debilitated, enemy sign unfavourable. The list of houses is this project's generalisation from per-planet lists; the natal tests are Ch.47 sl.7-32 and the principle Ch.48 sl.1. A malefic in dignity in a good house still gives good results; a benefic debilitated in a bad house gives bad results. Dignity and house are computed once (parashari.planet-dignity) and reused.
rules.template: {planet} is {dignity} in the {h}th house; its period is read as {direction}.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: Ch.47 sl.5-6 (the position at the commencement of the dasha) is the next rule, not this one.
rules.verificationNote: Locator corrected: natal tests are Ch.47 sl.7-32 and Ch.48 sl.1.

rules.name: Dasha lord's house at the moment the dasha begins
rules.condition: Take the sidereal sign of the mahadasha lord at the dasha's start instant and count its house from the natal Lagna. In the Lagna, a trikona, exaltation, own or a friendly sign: favourable; in 6th, 8th, 12th, debilitation or an enemy sign: unfavourable. Both this and the birth placement are weighed.
rules.template: At the start of the {planet} period, {planet} stood in the {h}th house from the Lagna, in {dignity}.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: 'Start' is read as the transit chart at the dasha-start instant (the translation says 'Kundali cast for the beginning of a Dasha' in Ch.33). 'Shant Rasi' read as a friendly sign; the Sanskrit was not seen.
rules.verificationNote: Trikona added to the favourable houses as Ch.48 names it.

rules.name: Dasha lord's company
rules.condition: Mahadasha lord conjunct (same sign) the lord of Dharm (9), Karm (10), Putr (5), Dhan (2) or Bandhu (4): favourable. Conjunct lords of Ari (6), Randhr (8), Vyaya (12) or malefic planets: unfavourable. Aspect of a malefic is always unfavourable; aspect of a benefic softens. Aspect limited to the full seventh until Ch.26 is read.
rules.template: {planet} is joined by {companion}, which {raises_or_lowers} its period.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: Aspect rules beyond the full seventh were not read.
rules.verificationNote: Specific lords named as the text does; drishti statements added.

rules.name: Exchange between Lagna lord and the 9th or 10th lord
rules.condition: The 9th lord is in the Lagna and the Lagna lord in the 9th: both planets' dashas extremely beneficial. The 10th lord in the Lagna and the Lagna lord in the 10th: kingship (read: high position) in the dashas of both.
rules.template: The lords of the Lagna and the {h}th exchange places; the dashas of both are strongly favourable.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: Owns this clause; parashari.dasha-lord-career-10 no longer repeats it.

rules.name: Rahu or Ketu as dasha lord
rules.condition: Rahu dasha judged by house and company. Favourable with benefics in Tanu (1), Bandhu (4), Yuvati (7), Karm (10), Labh (11) or Sahaj (3) (Ch.47 sl.34-39); 6th only through the Ch.48 sl.20 parenthesis (favourable in 3, 6, 11); exaltation Taurus. Unfavourable in Randhr (8), Vyaya (12), debility, or with a malefic or maraka lord (sl.40-43). Timing for an afflicted Rahu: loss at the start, relief in the middle, distress at the end. KETU: the Ketu verses were not read; treating Ketu like Rahu is an assumption and Ketu emits 'activates' only.
rules.template: {node} runs the period from the {h}th house, joined by {planet}; read as {direction}.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: The engine uses the mean node; sources do not say which node they mean. Exaltation sign varies by authority (see parashari.planet-dignity).
rules.verificationNote: Houses corrected (3 and 11 added); Ketu limited to activates; timing clause added.

rules.name: When in the dasha the effect falls (decanate rule)
rules.condition: Sidereal longitude of the dasha lord at birth: first 10 degrees of its sign, effects at the start of the dasha; 10-20 degrees, the middle; 20-30 degrees, the end. If the planet is retrograde at birth the order reverses. Rahu and Ketu always reverse.
rules.template: The effects of {planet}'s period fall mostly in the {third}.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: The text says 'Dreshkan'; read here as the 10-degree third of a sign. Some authorities use the Parashari drekkana with element rotation.

rules.name: Antardasha lord in 6, 8 or 12 from the dasha lord (planet-specific)
rules.condition: Antardasha lord's sidereal sign is the 6th, 8th or 12th counted from the mahadasha lord's sign. The set is PLANET-SPECIFIC in the chapters read: Candra 6/8/12 (Ch.52 sl.13-14); Mangala 8/12 (sl.19-20); Rahu 8/12 (sl.27-29); Guru 6/8; others in later chapters 6/8/12 or 8/12 (not all read). Where the planet's own verse set is not recorded, the rule emits nothing for that planet (no blanket 6/8/12). Effects named: mental agony, disputes, loss of wealth, illness, imprisonment, journeys to difficult places. Stronger when the antardasha lord is also weak or malefic. The dvirdvadasha 2/12 pair is not in the verses read.
rules.template: The {antar} sub-period lies in the {n}th place from {maha}, the dasha lord: an unfavourable sub-period.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.sourceLocator: Ch.52 sl.13-14, 19-20, 43-44 (and the parallel verses in each following antardasha chapter, Ch.53-60)
rules.variants: Ch.53-60 were sampled only. The locator sl.43-44 is not confirmed.
rules.verificationNote: Made planet-specific; blanket 6/8/12 removed.

rules.name: Antardasha lord in a kendra, trikona or 11th from the dasha lord
rules.condition: Antardasha lord in the 1st, 9th or a kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) from the mahadasha lord (Ch.52 sl.11-12), and in later chapters also the 11th (very common), 5th, 2nd and 3rd for some pairs: auspicious (marriage, children, gain of clothes, land, conveyances, fortune). The natural-benefic qualifier is not applied to the later chapters. Favourable set: kendra, trikona, 11th; the planet-specific 2nd and 3rd only where that planet's verse gives them (not recorded, so not used).
rules.template: The {antar} sub-period lies in the {n}th place from {maha}: a favourable sub-period.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: The 5th is named in later chapters.
rules.verificationNote: Favourable set widened to kendra, trikona, 11th.

rules.name: Antardasha lord's own dignity and house
rules.condition: Antardasha lord exalted, in own sign, in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from the Lagna (or friendly sign, or with a friendly planet): favourable. Debilitated, or in 6/8/12 from the Lagna, or with malefics: unfavourable. The reference point (Lagna for Surya and the Mangala sections Ch.52 sl.9-12; the dasha lord for sl.13-14) is named per planet; the same-planet case (antardasha lord equals mahadasha lord) is stated only for Surya in Surya (Ch.52 sl.1-3).
rules.template: {antar}, {dignity} in the {h}th house, gives a {direction} sub-period.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: Mangal's bad placement (sl.19-20) is from the dasha lord, not the Lagna.
rules.verificationNote: Reference point named per planet.

rules.name: Antardasha lord is a maraka (2nd or 7th lord)
rules.condition: Antardasha lord is the lord of the 2nd or 7th house. Stated per planet: Surya (Ch.52 sl.1-3) and Candra (sl.13-14): danger of premature death or death-like suffering; Mangala (sl.21-22): diseases of mind and body, recoverable. Other planets unread. Output wording is 'health caution' only; no mortality statement.
rules.template: {antar} is a maraka lord; health caution in this sub-period.
rules.sourceCitation: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, English translation with additions from Santhanam (see parashari.house-topic-map for edition note).
rules.variants: Remedial worship is prescribed in the text; not reproduced.
rules.verificationNote: Stated per planet; only Surya, Candra, Mangala covered.

rules.name: Jupiter over the 2nd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th from the natal Moon
rules.condition: Transiting Jupiter's sidereal sign is the 2nd, 5th, 7th, 9th or 11th counted (whole-sign) from the natal Moon's sidereal sign and the vedha point is free (parashari.jupiter-vedha). Topics by house, in the project's words: 2nd, money and a settled home; 5th, children, good company, favour from rulers (general; learning is not named by either source); 7th, a good journey and a happy marriage (relationships); 9th, every kind of thriving (general, and wealth per Raman); 11th, children, a new post, honour (career; 'gain' is Raman's, attributed separately).
rules.template: Jupiter transits the {h}th sign from your natal Moon from {start} to {end}; the {h}th is a favourable house.
rules.sourceCitation: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri (1937; 2nd ed. 1950), archive.org item in.ernet.dli.2015.92117; B. V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology (Bangalore: Raman Publications, 8th ed., 1963).
rules.sourceLocator: Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI sl.2, 7, 18-20; Raman Ch.XXXIV (table of good houses; p.419-420 for the wealth wording)
rules.variants: Sl.2 names 7, 9, 2, 5 and a separate clause names 11 for all planets; sl.18-20 describes the 11th as gain. Raman lists 2, 5, 7, 9, 11 and reads yearly effects from Jupiter (p.409).
rules.verificationNote: Topic 'learning' removed for the 5th; sources attributed per house.

rules.name: Jupiter over the other houses from the Moon
rules.condition: Transiting Jupiter's sign is the 1st, 3rd, 4th, 6th, 8th, 10th or 12th from the natal Moon. The source says: 1st, a move out of the home country and heavy spending; 3rd, a lost post, business held back, disease; 4th, grief caused by kin; 6th, enemies make trouble and illness follows; 8th, weariness and money lost; 10th, property, post and children put at risk; 12th, worry and dread about property.
rules.template: Jupiter transits the {h}th sign from your natal Moon from {start} to {end}; the {h}th is an unfavourable house.
rules.sourceCitation: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri (1937; 2nd ed. 1950), archive.org item in.ernet.dli.2015.92117.
rules.variants: Jupiter in the 12th is counted as bad in sl.20; Raman agrees in sign.

rules.name: Jupiter's vedha (obstruction)
rules.condition: Jupiter in a favourable house is nullified if any other planet transits its vedha house at the same moment: Jupiter 2 with 12; 11 with 8; 9 with 10; 5 with 4; 7 with 3 (counted from the natal Moon). No vedha between Sun and Saturn or Moon and Mercury (Raman). Whether the nodes obstruct is not stated.
inputs: sidereal positions of Sun to Saturn at t
rules.template: Jupiter's good transit over the {h}th is obstructed by {planet} in the {v}th.
rules.sourceCitation: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri (1937; 2nd ed. 1950), archive.org item in.ernet.dli.2015.92117; B. V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology (Bangalore: Raman Publications, 8th ed., 1963).
rules.sourceLocator: Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI sl.7; Raman Ch.XXXIV p.411-413
rules.variants: Raman says present-day astrologers often skip vedha.

rules.name: Saturn over the 3rd, 6th or 11th from the natal Moon
rules.condition: Transiting Saturn's sidereal sign is the 3rd, 6th or 11th from the natal Moon's sign (vedha houses 12, 9, 5). Effects: 3 position, employment, servants, money; 6 happiness all round; 11 happiness, wealth, honour.
rules.template: Saturn transits the {h}th sign from your natal Moon from {start} to {end}; favourable for gain and position.
rules.sourceCitation: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri (1937; 2nd ed. 1950), archive.org item in.ernet.dli.2015.92117; B. V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology (Bangalore: Raman Publications, 8th ed., 1963).
rules.sourceLocator: Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI sl.2, 5, 22-23; Raman Ch.XXXIV p.422-423
rules.variants: Raman for the 11th also says the person becomes 'cruel', differing from the happiness in Phaladeepika sl.23.

rules.name: Saturn over the 12th from the natal Moon
rules.condition: Transiting Saturn's sidereal sign is the sign before the natal Moon's sign. The source says work done in this stay is tiring and brings nothing, enemies take his money, and his wife and sons fall ill. The three-sign grouping 'sade sati' is a later popular convention, not in the opened texts, and is shown only as a label from ingress dates.
rules.template: Saturn transits the 12th sign from your natal Moon from {start} to {end}: wearying business and loss to enemies.
rules.sourceCitation: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri (1937; 2nd ed. 1950), archive.org item in.ernet.dli.2015.92117; B. V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology (Bangalore: Raman Publications, 8th ed., 1963).
rules.sourceLocator: Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI sl.22-23; Raman Ch.XXXIV p.422-423
rules.variants: Popular sources differ on counting by sign or degree; no source opened for the degree version.
rules.verificationNote: Split from the sade-sati bundle.

rules.name: Saturn over the sign of the natal Moon
rules.condition: Transiting Saturn's sidereal sign is the natal Moon's sign. Effects: disease, funeral rites (Phaladeepika) or poison, fire, imprisonment, journey abroad, loss of wealth and sons (Raman).
rules.template: Saturn transits your natal Moon sign from {start} to {end}: strain on health and means.
rules.sourceCitation: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri (1937; 2nd ed. 1950), archive.org item in.ernet.dli.2015.92117; B. V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology (Bangalore: Raman Publications, 8th ed., 1963).
rules.sourceLocator: Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI sl.22-23; Raman Ch.XXXIV p.422-423
rules.variants: Phaladeepika and Raman differ in detail but agree in sign.
rules.verificationNote: Split from the sade-sati bundle.

rules.name: Saturn over the 2nd from the natal Moon
rules.condition: Transiting Saturn's sidereal sign is the sign after the natal Moon's sign. Effects: trouble to wealth and children (Phaladeepika) or loss of comfort, wealth got from others not long enjoyed (Raman). Practitioners vary on how bad the 2nd is; both sources here call it unfavourable.
rules.template: Saturn transits the 2nd sign from your natal Moon from {start} to {end}: trouble to wealth.
rules.sourceCitation: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri (1937; 2nd ed. 1950), archive.org item in.ernet.dli.2015.92117; B. V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology (Bangalore: Raman Publications, 8th ed., 1963).
rules.sourceLocator: Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI sl.22-23; Raman Ch.XXXIV p.422-423
rules.variants: As above.
rules.verificationNote: Split from the sade-sati bundle.

rules.name: Saturn over the 8th from the natal Moon
rules.condition: Transiting Saturn's sidereal sign is the 8th from the natal Moon's sign. The source lists four losses: children, cattle, friends and wealth. It adds disease. Raman adds being parted from wife and sons, and a journey made in misery.
rules.template: Saturn transits the 8th sign from your natal Moon from {start} to {end}; strain on wealth, health and close ties.
rules.sourceCitation: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri (1937; 2nd ed. 1950), archive.org item in.ernet.dli.2015.92117; B. V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology (Bangalore: Raman Publications, 8th ed., 1963).
rules.sourceLocator: Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI sl.22; Raman Ch.XXXIV p.423
rules.variants: BPHS Ch.34 and Ch.44 (not opened) concern maraka lords; the transit-from-Moon rule is Phaladeepika and later.

rules.name: Saturn over the 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th, 10th from the natal Moon
rules.condition: Transiting Saturn's sign is the 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th or 10th from the natal Moon's sign. The source says: 4th, wife, kin and wealth are lost; 5th, wealth shrinks, children are lost and the mind is clouded; 7th, the wife suffers, a journey is made, fear follows; 9th, money is lost and good deeds are hindered; 10th, a sinful deed, honour lost, sickness (Raman: work is done but wealth, learning and fame are lost; mixed).
rules.template: Saturn transits the {h}th sign from your natal Moon from {start} to {end}; unfavourable.
rules.sourceCitation: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri (1937; 2nd ed. 1950), archive.org item in.ernet.dli.2015.92117.
rules.variants: Kantaka Shani and ashtama Shani as names are later usage, not in the verses opened.

rules.name: Saturn's vedha
rules.condition: Saturn's good transit (3, 6, 11) is nullified by another planet (not the Sun) in 12, 9, 5 respectively, counted from the natal Moon.
inputs: positions of other planets at t
rules.template: Saturn's good transit is obstructed by {planet} in the {v}th.
rules.sourceCitation: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri (1937; 2nd ed. 1950), archive.org item in.ernet.dli.2015.92117; B. V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology (Bangalore: Raman Publications, 8th ed., 1963).
rules.sourceLocator: Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI sl.5; Raman Ch.XXXIV p.412-413
rules.variants: Sl.5: Saturn is not marred by the Sun in the vedha place (Sun is Saturn's father).

rules.name: Which part of the sign the transit works in
rules.condition: Jupiter and Venus give their transit effect in the middle 10 degrees of the sign (10-20), Saturn and the Moon in the last 10 degrees (20-30), Mars and the Sun in the first 10 degrees, Mercury and Rahu throughout. Ketu is not covered. It narrows the Jupiter and Saturn windows and CONFLICTS with whole-sign ingress-to-egress date spans: the engine shows it as a sub-window annotation on a whole-sign signal and never replaces the span.
rules.template: {planet} is in the {part} part of its sign, where its transit effect is held to be strongest.
rules.sourceCitation: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri (1937; 2nd ed. 1950), archive.org item in.ernet.dli.2015.92117; B. V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology (Bangalore: Raman Publications, 8th ed., 1963).
rules.sourceLocator: Phaladeepika Adh.XXVI sl.25 (printed as a second sl.26); Raman Ch.XXXIV p.409 (Sun and Mars first 10 degrees only)
rules.variants: Raman states only the Sun and Mars portion. The printed verse numbers in the scan are repeated, so the verse number is inferred from order.
